description:
Free, read-only check-up of a Decibel account (wallet or Trading Account address):
        margin buffer, distance to liquidation, positions without a stop-loss, fees,
        maker/taker share, win rate, net result after fees (Decibel's own portfolio PnL) and
        funding over the period, plus how it compares with the other accounts checked on
        Pitbi. days: 7 (default, no registration) or 30 (registered agents, with api_key);
        a longer period than allowed falls back to the longest allowed. Nothing signed, the
        address is not stored.

api_key.description: Your agent's api_key. Leave empty if your MCP client sends the header 'Authorization: Bearer <api_key>' (better: the key stays out of the conversation).
api_key.title: Api Key

name: check_account
